description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between four different data sources—Tutorials, Library Documentation, StackOverflow posts, and Github files—and an unspecified metric across varying token counts. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Tokens" and features a linear scale ranging from 200 to 1000, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 200. The y-axis lacks a label but utilizes a linear scale ranging from 10 to 40, with tick marks at intervals of 10. All four data sources are represented by solid lines with circular markers plotted at x-values of 200, 500, 800, and 1000. The "Tutorials" line, depicted in blue, starts at a value of approximately 23 at 200 tokens, rises to roughly 27 at 500 tokens, reaches a peak of about 29 at 800 tokens, and ends slightly lower at approximately 28.5 at 1000 tokens. The "Library Documentation" line, shown in red, begins at approximately 26 at 200 tokens, increases to roughly 29 at 500 tokens, peaks at about 32 at 800 tokens, and declines to roughly 27 at 1000 tokens. The "StackOverflow posts" line, colored yellow, exhibits a steady decline across the entire x-axis, starting at its highest point of approximately 33 at 200 tokens, dropping to roughly 30 at 500 tokens, continuing down to about 19 at 800 tokens, and ending at approximately 11 at 1000 tokens. Finally, the "Github files" line, colored green, starts at approximately 28 at 200 tokens, rises to roughly 30.5 at 500 tokens, peaks at about 33 at 800 tokens, and decreases to approximately 30 at the end of the x-axis at 1000 tokens.
